upstream.name: frxUSD — 92.5% of all collateral value, AND the exit venue's quote asset
upstream.metric: 722,605 frxUSD in the stability module + 37,270 frxUSD posted in the frxUSD mint market = 759,875 of ~$909,388 total collateral value
upstream.source: riskAnalyst on-chain reads at block 26,017,854, re-confirmed 26,020,013 (2026-09-21)
upstream.note: ⚠️ THIS IS THE ASSET'S BINDING DEPENDENCY AND IT IS NOT MERELY A PRICE CORRELATION. frxUSD is the reserve, it is the Curve pool's quote asset, and as of 2026-09-21 the zero-cost dollar leg runs through a Frax contract. A frxUSD stress event impairs the backing and the exit simultaneously, and there is no leg that survives it independently. DUSD cannot be worth more than frxUSD. The frxUSD mint market at 128% adds leverage on the same asset rather than diversifying it.

upstream.name: ⚠️ One issuer's four keys reach the reserve, the quote asset and the dollar leg
upstream.metric: Frax Safe 0xfFFffF4F3baC444b2C0ecf2A1840d018bE783937, 4-of-7, seven EOAs; Timelock 0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503 delay 86,400s / MINIMUM_DELAY 7,200s
upstream.source: riskAnalyst live reads 2026-09-21; frxUSD ProxyAdmin 0x0b2c3df006b2bd43CbCC60075e7A0bf314474Ed6; custodian 0x4f95c5ba0c7c69fb2f9340e190ccee890b3bd87c ProxyAdmin 0x1a4563f238fa693ba9771cdba5ee8280a114ed7e
upstream.note: ⚠️ THE ACTUAL FINDING, and it is stronger than the concentration figure above. frxUSD's mint/freeze/pause execute with NO delay; its upgrades sit behind the 24h Timelock the same Safe administers (2h floor, so the Safe can lower its own gate). The frxUSD→USDC custodian that makes DUSD's dollar exit free is an UPGRADEABLE PROXY whose ProxyAdmin owner is that same Timelock and whose own owner() is that same Safe. So the reserve, the venue's quote asset and the dollar leg correlate through ONE ISSUER'S FOUR KEYS, not through one asset's price. Losing the custodian costs 0.86–2.4 bps, not the exit — this is a governance concentration, not an imminent liquidity risk.

upstream.name: Frax frxUSD→USDC redemption custodian — free, and Frax's inventory rather than DUSD's property
upstream.metric: ERC-4626, asset() = USDC, previewRedeem(1000e18) = 1000.000000 (1:1, zero fee); USDC pocket read 59,195.58 → 72,836.03 → 32,919.58 across 2026-09-21
upstream.source: riskAnalyst live reads + redeem() simulation, 2026-09-21; DexTracker ladder at block 26,022,595
upstream.note: ⚠️ redeem() is NOT permissioned — a real holder reverts only on ERC20InsufficientAllowance, a normal approve step — but it IS HARD-CAPPED AT THE POCKET BY A REVERT, NOT BY A WORSE PRICE: redeem(100,000) reverts ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(shares 99,999.99, max 32,919.582897). A cliff, not graceful degradation. The pocket swung 23% in ten minutes and closed the day barely above the 23,935 float. Past it the crvUSD route costs ~1bp/hop, so the cost verdict is unaffected.
